# Dotfiles

Welcome to my dotfiles repository! This repository contains my personal configuration files for various tools and environments. These files help set up and customize my development environment efficiently.

## Getting Started

1. Install `yadm`.
2. Clone the repository.

```bash
yadm clone git@github.com:Kohei-Wada/dotfiles
yadm alt
yadm bootstrap
```
